scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w server && npm run test -w server
scripts.test:embedded: npm run build -w server && USE_EMBEDDED_TEST_DATABASE=true npm run test -w server
scripts.test:browser: npm run build -w server && node scripts/browser-tests.mjs
